(ja)༄༅/ /gu ru drag dmar me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /chos sku spros bral dbying

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// gu ru drag dmar me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs// chos sku spros bral dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// gzugs sku khro chen 'bar bas 'jig rten gyi// dregs pa 'dul mdzad thod phreng rtsal btud de// nyang lugs drag po pad+ma'i rjes gnang bri// de'ang mnga' bdag nyang nas brgyud pa'i gu ru drag dmar gyi rjes gnang byed par/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi khar rdul tshon gyi

zla gam sgo gcig pa bri ba 'di/ snga ma'i yig cha rnams su byung ba/ 'og tu bskyed du med kyang lha 'di dbang gi drag po yin pa'i mtshon byed tsam byas pa yin nam snyam/ de ltar yin na lha bskyed skabs zla gam tshom bu bcas lha skur bskyed dgos pa 'dra'o// zla gam dmar po sgo gcig pa bris pa'am bsdu na tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su bris pa'am yang na tshom bu bkod pas kyang btub ste/ de'i steng man ji'i khar dpal gtor rin chen 'bar ba sku gzugs kyis brgyan pa/ de'i g.yas su gsung gi dbang rdzas thod pa mtshan ldan du/ chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa dang*/ g.yon du 'bru'i khar thugs kyi dbang rdzas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje bzhag pa dang*/ sman phud rak+ta dang nyer spyod bcas pa bsham mo// thog mar yo byad rnams byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyi yi ge gsum 'phros pas/ mchod rdzas rnams kyi nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus te sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ sman rag gtor ma rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes so so'i phyag rgya bcas dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥzhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro la/ bla ma yi dam la sogs pa'i skyabs gnas thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rtse gcig tu skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// na mo thugs rjes 'gro la dgongs mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// rtse gcig thugs rjes byin rlobs pa'i// yi dam lha la=

/rtsod bzlog med pa'i thugs rje can// sangs rgyas rnams la= /chags pa med pa'i 'gro don can// dam pa'i chos la= /ma nor lam la mnga' mdzad pa'i// dge 'dun rnams la= /'gro ba'i don du rang byung sku 'khrungs pa'i// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la= /nyes legs stong 'dzin dam tshig rjes skyong ba'i// phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi// na mo brgyud pa'i rtsa ba bla ma rje// dngos grub 'byung ba'i yi dam lha// legs par byin rlabs mkha' 'gro ste// rtsa ba gsum la skyabs su mchi// rtsa ba gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro lan gsum/ bsdu na tshigs bcad dang po de lan gsum brjod/ sems bskyed ni/ na mo sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni// gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis// 'gro drug bsgral bar dam 'cha'o// zhes lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis gu ru drag po'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi'o snyam pas ngag tu/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags// gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang*// smin grol gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// snying po sems can don du bsngo// yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /ces pa lan gsum brjod/ dngos gzhi lhar bskyed pa la/ bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi rten rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing ga yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ las thod pa mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang phyi nang thams cad me rlung dmar nag 'bar ba/

de'i nang du pad+ma nyi ma zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po/ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa las/ bdag mdun tha mi dad du gu ru drug po sku mdog dmar po me'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa spyan gsum bgrad pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra snub 'bol gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sku stod la glang lpags dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi'i na bza' gsol ba/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i 'og lpags can/ khrag gi thig le dang*/ zhag gi zo ris dang*/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ zhabs 'dor thabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi gtsug na bya khyung mthing nag me'i gshog pa can/ gnam lcags kyi thog dang me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ de'i steng du rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ dpral ba'i mdzod spur 'jam dpal sku mdog gser po g.yas ral gri bsnams pa/ mgrin par rta mgrin dmar po g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ thugs kar phyag na rdo rje mthing nag g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba/ g.yon pa thams cad thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gsang bar khro bo yak+sha me dbal sku mdog dmar nag g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon tho ba bsnams pa/ de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ yi ge gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams dang phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi lha la thim pas ye shes pa'i 'dres pa dang dbang bskur ba lhan cig tu gyur par bsam/

mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ yang sngags de nyid la/ ma hā pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta pi pa tha āḥhūm̐/ zhes btags pas sman dang rak+ta phul/ gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig sogs kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ rab byung pad+ma thod phreng drag po'i sku// dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad 'dul mdzad cing*// 'khor ba ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal gyur pa'i// gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs phyag 'tshal bstod// nad gdon bar chad mtha' dag zhi ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes brjod do// bzlas pa ni/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi thugs ka'i phyag rdor gyi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi bar byas/ gu ru'i byin rlabs thams cad bsdus nas rang la zhugs par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ a hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ci nus bzlas mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas bdag nyid lhar gsal ba bye ste/ rang gnas su 'khod par bsam/ de nas slob ma khrus byas phyag phul nas gral la 'khod pa la/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad ces pa nas/ gu ru drag po'i rjes su gnang ba zhu snyam pa'i sems bskyed gsal btab/ de la 'dir gsan par bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ au rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/

srog bdag rgyal 'gong la sogs pa'i 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can rnams 'dul ba'i gnyen por che mchog gu ru drag po'i skur bzhengs te/ lha srin sde brgyad spyi dang*/ bye brag tu srog bdag rgyal 'gong pe kar la sogs pa'i gdug pa can thams cad btul te/ de dag gi srog snying bzhes te dam la btags nas/ phyi rabs ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus su sems can thams cad la phan 'dogs che bar rjes su dgongs nas/ gter kha mang por gu ru drag dmar gyi chos skor 'jog par mdzad pa las/ da lan 'dir slob dpon chen po nyid kyi sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol pa mnga' bdag nyang ral pa can gyis lho brag srin mo sbar rjes nas spyan drangs pa'i chos skor zab rgyas/ da ltar rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la bka' srol ma nub par bzhugs pa las/ slob ma gzhug pa'i rim pa la'ang byin rlabs dbang gi rim pa dang*/ rjes su gnang ba gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir rjes su gnang ba yin/ de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin nas/ slob ma la bya ba ni/ slob dpon gu ru drag por gsal ba la rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// bdag ni 'khor ba'i duḥkha las// bsgral phyir byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab nas/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dang*/ khyad par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo slob dpon chen po pad+ma drag po la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par dmigs pa la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rtse gcig tu skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// zhes pa nas/ rtsa ba gsum gyi byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod/

bsdu na tshigs bcad dang po de ka lan gsum gyis chog de nas sems can gyi don du rang nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de thob nas gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ na mo sems bskyed sogs lan gsum/ slar yang yul de dag gi spyan sngar phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lam sgrub par rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ smin grol sngags kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba dang*/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ste thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dgongs// zhes pa nas/ yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /ces pa'i bar lan gsum/ de nas bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sogs gzhi lus sbyangs nas/ stong pa'i ngang las chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs nas slob ma gu ru drag dmar du gong ltar bskyed la/ gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal gdab/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ au rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas/ gu ru drag po thod phreng rtsal gyi lha tshogs la dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams gu ru drag por gsal ba'i sku lus la sib sib thim pas nad gdon sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad cing zhi bar byas par mos pa mdzod/ dril gsil rol chen bya zhing rtsa sngags brjod/ de nas gtor ma gu ru drag por gsal ba spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du ba'i phyir// dam rdzas gtor mas dbang bskur bas// sku yi byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus kyi sgrib pa byang gyur nas// sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku'i rang bzhin 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas thim zhing dbang bskur bas mgrin pa yan chad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku dmar lam gyis gyur snyam pa ni sku'i byin gyis brlab pa ste/ gtor ma nas cung zad bcad nas sbyin/ mdun bskyed kyi gsung gi rang bzhin bdud rtsi'i thod pa mgrin par bzhag la/ āḥbla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyis// mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du ba'i phyir// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas// gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag gi dri ma byang gyur nas// gsung snying po sngags kyi dngos grub stsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ zhes dang bdud rtsi byin pas khyed rang gi mgrin pa nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi gsung gi rang bzhin bdud rtsi dmar pos thim zhing dbang bskur bas/ lte ba yan chad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku dmar lam gyis gyur snyam pa ni gsung gis byin gyis brlab pa'o// mdun bskyed kyi thugs kyi rang bzhin lcags kyi rdo rje snying gar bzhag la/ hūm̐ bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyi// mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir// dam tshig rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs// yid kyi sgrib pa byang gyur nas// thugs skye med rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ drag po thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ khyed rang gi snying ga nas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi thugs kyi rang bzhin gyi rdo rjes thim zhing dbang bskur bas lte ba man chad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi sku dmar lam gyis gyur snyam pa ni thugs kyi byin rlabs te rdzas la brten pa'i byin brlab bo// slar yang bla ma'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros/

zhal nas drag po'i sngags tshar gcig brjod pas 'od zer gyis khyed rnams la phog pas/ lha'i sku rgyan gyi lha cha byad thams cad rdzogs par bkra lam gyis gsal thob cig da ni sku'i dbang dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos la/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ slob mas bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ de ni gsung gi dbang dang*/ khyed rnams lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid gtad pas/ gsal snang 'od gsal gyi ngang du bsdus te/ mi dmigs par sems gnas lugs kyi ngang du cung zad cig 'jog pa ni thugs kyi dbang ste/ de ltar dbang de thob nas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul/ de dag gis mnga' bdag nyang ral chen po'i lugs kyi gu ru drag po dmar po me'i phreng ba can gyi rjes su gnang ba thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rang gnas su gtang ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa skye med kyi klong du gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag pad+ma dbang drag 'grub gyur sogs kyis dge ba gzhan don du bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis brjod do// smras pa/ snang srid dregs pa zil mnan rang dbang du/ sdud byed drag po pad+ma'i sgrub thabs dang*// rjes gnang cho ga rnam gsal me long 'di// ldan phrug pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis bskrun// dge bas 'gro sems rdzing bu 'khrul snang gi /lha 'drer kun rtog glang pos rnyog pa'i rdul// dmigs med snying rje'i ke ta kas bgrungs par// cir snang dge ba'i zla snang ston gyur cig

/ces gu ru drag dmar me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga rnam gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di ni/ gong mas byas pa'i yi ge ha cang bsdus ches pas mi gsal bar gyur pa/ lag tu blang bde ba zhig dgos zhes don gnyer 'gas bskul ngor/ nyang chen gzhung la sogs pa yig rnying sgrub thabs che 'bring dang*/ byin rlabs dbang chog rgyas bsdus rnams kyi bzhed pa dang mthun par/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi ba gam gsum par bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha ban+tu// // ༄// mnga' bdag nyang lugs kyi bla ma drag po me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dregs pa 'dul byed ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// snang srid dregs pa'i sde tshogs dbang sdud cing*// bran du bkol ba pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// gus pas phyag 'tshal de yi sgrub pa'i thabs// nyang chen mkhas pa'i lugs srol 'dir spel lo// de la dang po sngon 'gro skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni// gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis// 'gro drug bsgral bar dam bca'o// mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐ nga ni ye nas ngang gis khro// mtshams gcod khro bos nam mkha' gang*// bgegs 'dul khro bos rol mtshams las// su yang 'da' bar ma byed cig /a rtsig ni rtsig dang oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ spro na yan lag bdun pa ni/ hūm̐ drag po rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams// 'dir byon nyi zla pad+mar bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags// gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang*// smin grol gsang sngags 'khor lo bskor// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// snying po sems can don du bsngo// yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog

/gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings// snying rje'i rang gdangs hūm̐ gyur las// e yaṃ raṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐/ de las nam mkha' rlung me khrag /zhing thang rus pa'i ri rab 'bar// de steng rdo rje'i gur nang du// lcags sdig mtshan pa'i gser dang me'i// 'khor lo g.yas g.yon 'khor ba yi// rtse bsnol bar du dgra bgegs 'joms// dbus su mi mgo'i gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dbus// pad+ma zla nyi dregs pa'i sgyel// de steng hūm̐ las bdag mdun lha// che mchog pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// dmar po me'i phreng bas brgyan// phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar// g.yon pas lcags sdig mgo dgu bsnams// rab khros dur khrod chas rdzogs sku// me dpung 'bar klong brkyang bskum bzhengs// spyi gtsug bya khyung mthing nag la// de steng snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs// dpral bar 'jam dpal oṃ gyis mtshan// mgrin par rta mgrin āḥyis mtshan// thugs kar phyag rdor hūm̐ gis mtshan// 'bru gsum 'od kyi sku gsung thugs// lha tshogs rgyal ba kun spyan drangs// lha gsum rigs bdag bcas la thim// byin rlabs dbang bskur ma lus thob// snying ga'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gi tshogs// grangs med spros pa las byung ba'i// yak+sha me dbal khros pa'i sku// nag po rdo rje tho ba can// snang srid thams cad gang gyur pas// gnod byed gdon bgegs brdung zhing bsregs// srog gi sa bon 'od zer gyis// ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur// hūm̐ dur khrod smug nag me 'bar klong dkyil nas// dregs pa 'dul mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs// sems can don phyir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// tshur byon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi nang mchod gtor snang stong gzugs// ye shes rol par rgyas gyur cig /mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ bdud rtsi sman gtor rak+ta'i mtsho// nyer spyod bdun sogs mchod pa'i sprin// gu ru drag po'i tshogs la 'bul// bdud rtsi rak+ta pi pa tha/ i daṃ ba liṃ khā hi hoḥ sarba pū dza so sor bzhes// bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bskal pa snyigs ma'i sems can la// byin rlabs thugs rje ches myur ba// lha srin dregs pa 'dul ba po// che mchog drag po'i tshogs la bstod// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs srog sa bon sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs// bdag dang yak+sha me dbal gyi// zhal nas sngags sgra 'brug stong ldir// me 'od spu gri 'thab pa'i bar// gnod byed gdon bgegs tshar bcad gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ a rtsig ni rtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces dang*/ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra yak+sha rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnod byed gdon bgegs rgyal 'gong bsen mo dam sri'i snying la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces btags pa'ang ci rigs bzlas mthar/ drag po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal// bdag sogs nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyong*// dregs pa dbang sdud las 'khol bar// khyod nyid 'dra bar byin gyis rlobs// ces 'dod gsol dang*/ gsum pa rjes ni/ snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// khams gsum bsgoms pa'i 'khor lor bcas// 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// rang dang cir snang lha ru gsal// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /pad+ma dbang drag 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs// gdul ka 'dul byed sogs kyi bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo// che mchog pad+ma drag po me phreng gi

/sgrub thabs dregs pa 'dul byed 'di bgyis pa'i// dge bas 'gro rnams bar chad 'jigs pa las// nyer bsgral bde mchog go sar 'khrid par shog /ces mnga' bdag nyang lugs kyi bla ma drag po me'i phreng ba can gyi sgrub thabs dregs pa 'dul byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi nye bar gnas pa dge slong lhun grub phun tshogs kyis 'don byar/ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi gsung rab dang mthun par nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bi dza yan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
